requirement_summary: Candidate/epoch promotion은 baseline 대비 precision/recall/FP/FN/coverage/latency/stability 변화를 기록해야 한다.
subject: src/main/java/kr/co/oruda/onsure/platform/SemanticAssuranceV2WorkflowService.java (learningEffectivenessEvaluate), assurance.learning.effectiveness.evaluate v2 operation; contracts/learning-effectiveness-report.v1.schema.json (Batch 5 object D, previously zero Java consumers)
observed_source: SemanticAssuranceV2DispatcherBridgeTest (real dispatch through the full RBAC/workflow chain)
coverage_notes: decision is computed from a real before/after (baseline/candidate) comparison across precision, recall, false_positive_rate, and false_negative_rate, not trusted from a caller-declared value. Any regression beyond a small tolerance on ANY of those four metrics forces REGRESSION, even when another metric improved -- directly closing the schema's own named negative case ('a real regression claiming IMPROVED'), so a caller cannot cherry-pick one better metric while masking a worse one. Confidence below a minimum threshold forces INCONCLUSIVE before any directional (IMPROVED/EQUIVALENT/REGRESSION) claim is made at all. before/after metric sets (precision/recall/false_positive_rate/false_negative_rate/coverage/latency_ms) are echoed back in full, satisfying the requirement's 'baseline 대비 변화를 기록' (record the change relative to baseline) obligation.
open_gap: Stability (the requirement's 6th named metric, alongside precision/recall/FP/FN/coverage/latency) is not yet a tracked field in learning-effectiveness-report.v1.schema.json or this computation -- the schema's metricSet has 6 fields (precision/recall/false_positive_rate/false_negative_rate/coverage/latency_ms) but no explicit stability metric. Disclosed as a real schema-level gap, not silently substituted with one of the existing fields.
design_reference_gap: REQUIREMENT_WITHOUT_DESIGN: the trace scanner correctly excludes the requirement's own authority document (146_LEARNING_VALIDATION_CLOSED_LOOP_AND_META_ASSURANCE.md) as circular; 149_LEARNING_VALIDATION_SCHEMA_FIXTURE_SPECIFICATION.md SS D elaborates the schema shape but is a companion/fixture-spec document in the same authority family, not an independent design elaboration.
